verdict.rationale: Sentry ships its own AI agent (Seer), so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question. The evidence only shows adjacent capabilities that earn no credit here: Sentry acting as an MCP server for other assistants (mcp.sentry.dev), monitoring of users' MCP servers, and handing Seer's analysis off to coding agents like Cursor. Nothing documents Sentry or Seer connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools.
